notes: One entry per OCS mandate_type. Used by the OCS ChainGraph artifact export system to annotate each artifact with context for downstream consumers (agents, prompts, Zenodo deposits). See CHAINGRAPH-OCS-CONFIG-V1_2026-06-13.md §2 for taxonomy rationale.

imbh_constraint.description: A mass constraint or model-consistency determination for the Omega Centauri IMBH. Output is a verdict on the allowed mass window given a set of active observational constraints.
regulatory_citations: Häberle et al. 2024, Nature 631:285 — lower bound 8,200 M☉ (proper motion of fast stars, HST)
Bañares-Hernández et al. 2025, A&A 693:A104 — 3σ upper limit 6,000 M☉ (kinematics + pulsar timing)
Chen et al. 2025, arXiv:2511.20945 — JWST accretion non-detection; constrains mass ≳ 20,000 M☉
Malave et al. 2025/2026, arXiv:2512.09649 — ATCA 170h radio non-detection; 1.1 μJy rms at 7.25 GHz
Colom i Bernadich et al. 2026, arXiv:2603.21845 — TRAPUM MeerKAT/Parkes pulsar timing; < 10⁵ M☉ at 90%
stochastic_framing_rules: Report mass constraints as 'the allowed window is X–Y M☉ at N-sigma'
Never present a kinematic constraint as a mass detection — it is a consistency test
Always distinguish lower bounds (kinematic, Häberle) from upper limits (pulsar, Bañares)
When tension_detected is true, frame as 'at least one analysis has unaccounted-for systematics'

output_field_glossary.allowed_window_M_solar: Mass range in solar masses simultaneously allowed by all active constraints. null if no bound in that direction.
output_field_glossary.tension_detected: True if the tightest lower bound exceeds the tightest upper limit.
output_field_glossary.n_constraints_active: Count of individual measurements whose method family is toggled on.
output_field_glossary.constraint_lanes_active: Which method families are active: kinematics, propermotion, timing, accretion, nbody.
output_field_glossary.lower_bound_source: Author + year string for the tightest active lower bound.
output_field_glossary.upper_limit_source: Author + year string for the tightest active upper limit.
output_field_glossary.epsilon_adaf: ADAF radiative efficiency used for JWST mass limit calculation.
output_field_glossary.rho_inf_kg_m3: Ambient gas density used for Bondi accretion rate estimate.
output_field_glossary.verdict: Human-readable one-sentence summary of the constraint outcome.

Execution hash: {{execution_hash}} (anchors this computation — cite this hash when referencing the result). The constraint verdict is: {{output_payload.verdict}}. Allowed mass window: {{output_payload.allowed_window_M_solar.lower}} – {{output_payload.allowed_window_M_solar.upper}} M☉. Tension detected: {{output_payload.tension_detected}}. {{n_constraints_active}} constraints from {{constraint_lanes_active}} method families are active. For a [TASK] addressed to [AUDIENCE]: frame the result as [FRAMING INSTRUCTION].

detection_verdict.description: A yes/no detectability determination for a specific instrument and observational configuration. Output is a structured verdict on whether the target signal exceeds a specified instrument sensitivity threshold.
regulatory_citations: ESA Gaia DR4 — expected December 2026; 4.5× proper-motion precision improvement over DR2
Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope — projected launch 2027; 10 μas/yr astrometry in OC core
LISA — projected launch 2034–2035; millihertz gravitational-wave sensitivity
ngEHT — sub-1 μas angular resolution; relevant for shadow imaging at OC distance
SKA-Mid — first light ~2028; 10× pulsar timing improvement over MeerKAT
stochastic_framing_rules: Report detection significance as 'detectable at N-sigma with [instrument]'
Distinguish 'detectable' (SNR > threshold in calculation) from 'detected' (observation completed)
When detectable is false, frame as 'current instruments insufficient; [recommended_followup] required'

output_field_glossary.detectable: Boolean — does the predicted signal exceed the instrument's 5-sigma sensitivity floor?
output_field_glossary.snr: Signal-to-noise ratio at current parameter values.
output_field_glossary.sigma_margin: Detection significance in units of sigma.
output_field_glossary.limiting_instrument: The instrument with the tightest sensitivity relevant to this configuration.
output_field_glossary.recommended_followup: Next-generation instrument or observation that would achieve detection.
output_field_glossary.verdict: Human-readable one-sentence summary of the detectability outcome.

detection_verdict.template_body: You are analyzing an OCS ChainGraph artifact from the {{tool_id}} tool. Execution hash: {{execution_hash}}. Detection verdict: {{output_payload.verdict}}. Detectable with current instruments: {{output_payload.detectable}}. For a [TASK] addressed to [AUDIENCE]: ...

bayesian_posterior.description: A probability or posterior odds distribution over competing hypotheses (IMBH vs dark cluster vs null, or Fermi Paradox hypotheses). Output is a dominant hypothesis and credible interval.
regulatory_citations: Häberle et al. 2024, Nature 631:285 — IMBH lower bound used as evidence input
Sandberg, Drexler & Ord 2018, arXiv:1806.02404 — Fermi Paradox dissolving paper
Drake 1961 — original Fermi equation parameterization
stochastic_framing_rules: Always report credible intervals, not just posterior mode: 'IMBH favored at 58% [45%–71% 90% CI]'
When using stochastic sampling (seed-parameterized), cite the seed to make the artifact reproducible
For Fermi Paradox outputs, frame P(N>1) as 'probability at least one other civilization exists today'

output_field_glossary.p_imbh: Posterior probability that OC harbors an IMBH.
output_field_glossary.p_dark_cluster: Posterior probability of extended dark mass without point IMBH.
output_field_glossary.verdict: Human-readable one-sentence summary of the posterior.

bayesian_posterior.template_body: You are analyzing an OCS ChainGraph artifact from the {{tool_id}} tool. Execution hash: {{execution_hash}}. Posterior verdict: {{output_payload.verdict}}. Dominant hypothesis: {{output_payload.dominant_hypothesis}}. For a [TASK] addressed to [AUDIENCE]: ...

seti_exclusion.description: An exclusion zone determination from technosignature observational limits. Output is whether a specific ETI signal configuration is excluded by current survey sensitivities.
regulatory_citations: WISE W4 5σ sensitivity — 6.0 mJy at 22 μm; relevant for Dyson sphere waste heat
Breakthrough Listen (BL) EIRP benchmark — 10¹³ W (Earth's total leaked RF power)
Chen et al. 2025, arXiv:2511.20945 — OC distance: 5.43 kpc
stochastic_framing_rules: Distinguish 'excluded' (signal would have been detected if present) from 'not detected' (null result, no exclusion claim)
Report exclusion as fraction of parameter space: 'excludes f > 0.18 at T = 300 K'
escalation_conditions: excluded = false for all survey channels

output_field_glossary.excluded: Boolean — does the current survey sensitivity exclude this signal at 5σ?
output_field_glossary.exclusion_covering_fraction: Fraction of Dyson sphere covering that would be excluded at the current temperature.

seti_exclusion.template_body: You are analyzing an OCS ChainGraph artifact from the {{tool_id}} tool. Execution hash: {{execution_hash}}. Exclusion verdict: {{output_payload.verdict}}. Excluded: {{output_payload.excluded}}. For a [TASK] addressed to [AUDIENCE]: ...

mth_computation.description: A Macro Transcension Hypothesis engineering computation. Output quantifies a Kardashev-scale energy advantage achievable via the BZ mechanism or ergosphere computation at the OC IMBH.
regulatory_citations: Blandford & Znajek 1977, MNRAS 179:433 — BZ mechanism for energy extraction from rotating BH
Kardashev 1964 — original K-scale energy classification
Bekenstein 1973, Phys Rev D — Bekenstein bound on information density
Landauer 1961, IBM J Res Dev — Landauer limit on energy cost per bit operation
stochastic_framing_rules: Always qualify Kardashev rung as 'achievable at current IMBH parameters' not as an empirical claim
Frame compute_ops_per_second as a theoretical ceiling, not an engineering specification
The MTH is a hypothesis; flag outputs with register: 'speculative'

output_field_glossary.bz_power_W: Blandford-Znajek jet power in watts at the specified BH mass and spin.
output_field_glossary.kardashev_rung: Kardashev scale value implied by the BZ power.
output_field_glossary.advantage_ratio_vs_earth: Ratio of BZ power to Earth's current total energy consumption.
output_field_glossary.compute_ops_per_second_estimate: Theoretical Bekenstein-limited operations per second at Landauer energy cost.
output_field_glossary.verdict: Human-readable summary of the MTH engineering computation.

mth_computation.template_body: You are analyzing an OCS ChainGraph artifact from the {{tool_id}} tool. Execution hash: {{execution_hash}}. MTH computation verdict: {{output_payload.verdict}}. Kardashev rung achievable: {{output_payload.kardashev_rung}}. For a [TASK] addressed to [AUDIENCE]: ...

observational_plan.description: A resource allocation and scheduling decision for an observing campaign. Output is a recommended instrument, required hours, feasibility verdict, and optional pre-registration anchor.
regulatory_citations: ESA Gaia DR4 — expected December 2026
Roman Space Telescope — projected launch 2027
SKA-Mid — first light ~2028
ELT — first light projected 2029
stochastic_framing_rules: Report feasibility as one of: feasible | feasible-with-conditions | infeasible
When recommended_action is 'pre-register', provide the execution hash as the pre-registration anchor

output_field_glossary.required_hours: Estimated telescope time in hours. 0 if existing data is sufficient.
output_field_glossary.recommended_action: Specific next action for the observer.
output_field_glossary.verdict: Human-readable summary of the observational plan.

cosmological_measure.description: A cosmological distance or lookback time measurement. Primarily used as a chain input provider for MTH tools rather than as a terminal decision node. Verdict is always 'reference'.
regulatory_citations: Planck 2018 cosmological parameters: H0 = 67.4 km/s/Mpc, Ωm = 0.315, ΩΛ = 0.685
stochastic_framing_rules: Output verdict is always 'reference — no action decision produced'
Do not promote as a decision node; use as chain input only

Cosmological measure: z={{output_payload.z}}, d={{output_payload.comoving_distance_Mpc}} Mpc, lookback {{output_payload.lookback_time_Gyr}} Gyr. Use as context or chain input.
